points.quote: `common/` | Shared contracts and models with no UI ... `browser/` | The workbench shell and layout ... (alongside `electron-browser/`)
`api/` | Bridges extensions across the process boundary
`services/` | Injected service implementations, not tied to one feature
`contrib/` has 3,269 files and no code of its own at the top level.
**One common file exposes each feature's internal API.** A feature publishes its API from a single `common` file.
**Other features depend only on that API.** They must not reach into another feature's internals.
